why: One edit: a `visual/sky_color` under the emeralds' wide shot's `music`. A cutscene's `music` admits exactly `audio/background_music` and `audio/music_volume`: its score is played by variant biomes that differ from the places only in their music, so the look of the cells the camera passes stays the places' own. `DW1031` refuses the line. It declares no unit.
